# interval coincides with

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalCoincidesWith`](gmeow-intervalCoincidesWith.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalCoincidesWith>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

Allen EQUALS: this interval and the related interval share the same temporal extent. Symmetric and transitive. TEMPORAL simultaneity only, never identity of the intervals themselves. (= [time:intervalEquals](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalEquals))
